definitionZh: 警报对话框是一种模式对话框，它会中断用户的工作流程以传达重要消息并获取响应。示例包括操作确认提示和错误消息确认。 Alertdialog 角色使辅助技术和浏览器能够将警报对话框与其他对话框区分开来，以便它们可以选择对警报对话框进行特殊处理，例如播放系统警报声音。
sourceDefinition: An alert dialog is a modal dialog that interrupts the user's workflow to communicate an important message and acquire a response. Examples include action confirmation prompts and error message confirmations. The alertdialog role enables assistive technologies and browsers to distinguish alert dialogs from other dialogs so they have the option of giving alert dialogs special treatment, such as playing a system alert sound.
